headline: Police in Argentina raided the homes of four 15-year-old pupils accused of making and selling AI-generated fake nude images of about 50 female classmates.
score_reason: Pool score kept: serious harm to minors and a repeating pattern, but all accounts are allegations.
importance_line: Around 50 girls and their families are affected and similar cases are reported at other Argentine schools, but the claims are allegations and the role of an adult who allegedly paid for the AI tool is unclear.
summary: The Buenos Aires Times reports, citing the Perfil newspaper for part of the account, that police searched the homes of four teenagers on 9 Oct 2026 in Lomas de Zamora, south of Buenos Aires, who are accused of using AI to make fake nude images of classmates from social media photos, sharing them on WhatsApp and trying to sell them on adult sites. Around 50 girls are believed to be affected, and families say the school knew for about a month, but the allegations have not been independently established.
notes: The article calls it the latest of several similar Argentine cases, including one at another school last week.
